members.name: data
members.description: Numeric field or variable on which to accumulate

overloads.semanticRole: Registers one or more numeric fields/variables to be subtotaled by break level during the next PRINT SELECTION report; must be called (together with BREAK LEVEL) before that report.

constraints: Must be executed, together with BREAK LEVEL, before every PRINT SELECTION report for which break/subtotal processing is wanted.
